prompt:
Create one finished opaque flat 16:9 landscape poster for an approachable adult neighborhood evening of seasonal food, local music and unhurried company, for a community digital screen. Its visual center is a sheltering overhead gathering: an open horseshoe of seated adults, shared dishes and a lap hand drum, with the invitation nestled in its irregular opening.

Build a deliberate plan-view montage, using broad opaque digital-painted silhouettes in aubergine and cool celadon. Large bent shoulders, knees, stools, arms and bowls join into a lively contour crossing the upper edge and both sides, opening widely toward the lower left. Heads are small simple overhead shapes, with anonymous adults leaning toward the same shared food and percussion; no identifiable performer or commercial identity. One painted arm reaches toward a shared bowl, and a percussion player's two clear hands belong to their body and meet a drum resting on their lap. Two substantial natural-color photographic incursions replace parts of the painted contour: a close overhead rice-and-fresh-spring-greens dish at upper left, and a cropped drum skin at lower right. Cut these crops along the dish/drum's actual curved edges so they overlap and interrupt the paint; they are integrated pictorial masses, not little rectangular photographs or documentary cards. Keep the drawing boldly simplified with purposeful broad brush edges, and the photo cuts crisp and contemporary.

The gathering's inner contour organizes several horizontal readable copy groups, instead of framing one rectangular text panel. The pale apricot opening is irregular, off-center toward the left, with a contemporary Korean serif title at its inner heart, hospitable and substantial, the compact English identity directly beneath and the food/music description below. Set the two-line schedule immediately above the identity near the top inner bend. Follow the right interior bend with the venue and entry pair, then place the purchase and participation pair at the lower-right return. The cup reminder and lingering invitation complete the reading path through the open lower-left end. Small painted overlaps enter the spaces between groups without crossing letters. The information is part of the montage's shifting inner boundary, not a generic title/date/footer grid. Use well-proportioned clear Korean sans for practical information, dark aubergine on quiet pale areas, generous word spacing and open counters. Keep all practical text comfortably readable at a 720-pixel-wide preview; make room through image contour and group spacing, never through miniature text. All sentences horizontal, no circular lettering. Maintain high contrast, no painted noise or photo detail behind text.

Use aubergine, pale apricot and celadon as active connected image masses, with natural food and drum tones. Finish as clean contemporary digital paint and sharp photographic incursions, no distressed age simulation. Food sharing, listening bodies and percussion must read as one communal gathering. Exclude the passive solid/near-solid/split-color gothic headline-and-information template with subordinate pictures, and the empty-wall/floor/room background made just to hold copy. This is a substantive image-led assembly, not typography-only, a room mockup, a contact sheet or multiple posters. No added writing, logos, watermark, QR, labels or pseudo-print anywhere.

Print only the following exact copy, each entry once. Preserve the exact Korean words, English capitals, word spaces and punctuation, including middle dots and the time range en dash. The group labels below are instructions only, never printed.
